controles.affirmation: Dell est une 'controlled company' au sens du NYSE et s'exempte de certaines regles de gouvernance
controles.verbatim_source: Because we are a controlled company, we may elect not to comply with certain corporate governance requirements under NYSE rules... Although we currently maintain a board composed of a majority of independent directors and three standing committees of the board composed entirely of independent directors, we may decide in the future to change our board membership and committee composition.
controles.correction_proposee: Dell QUALIFIE pour les exemptions mais ne les utilise pas a ce jour. Reformuler : 'Dell est une controlled company au sens du NYSE, statut qui l'autorise a s'exempter de certaines regles de gouvernance. Elle n'utilise pas ces exemptions a ce jour (conseil a majorite d'administrateurs independants, trois comites permanents entierement independants), mais indique pouvoir changer cette composition a l'avenir.'

controles.affirmation: Michael Dell (avec son trust familial) et les fonds Silver Lake controlent environ 91,7% des droits de vote au 9 mars 2026 ; les porteurs de Class C n'ont quasiment aucun poids et la societe ecrit que cela peut peser sur le cours et exposer a des exclusions d'indices
controles.verbatim_source: the MD stockholders and certain investment funds affiliated with Silver Lake Partners collectively held common stock representing approximately 91.7% of the total voting power of our outstanding common stock as of March 9, 2026. The limited ability of unaffiliated holders of the Class C Common Stock to influence matters requiring stockholder approval may adversely affect the trading price of the Class C Common Stock. / Because of our multi-class share structure, we have in the past been, and may in the future be, excluded from certain stock indices.
controles.correction_proposee: Detail de precision : le 10-K parle des 'MD stockholders' (Michael Dell + le Susan Lieberman Dell Separate Property Trust) et des 'SLP stockholders' (plusieurs fonds Silver Lake). 'Deux actionnaires' dans le hook est un raccourci ; preferer 'deux blocs actionnaires'.

controles.affirmation: Marge brute 17,8% au T1 FY2027, -330 points de base en un an, tiree par le mix serveurs IA ; marges annuelles 23,8% FY2024, 22,2% FY2025, 20,0% FY2026
controles.verbatim_source: During the first quarter of Fiscal 2027, gross margin percentage and non-GAAP gross margin percentage decreased 330 basis points to 17.8% and 350 basis points to 18.1%, respectively. The decreases were primarily driven by a shift in mix towards our AI-optimized servers offerings. / 10-K FY2026 : Total gross margin 22,707 20.0% / 21,250 22.2% / 21,069 23.8%

controles.affirmation: La majorite du CA des solutions IA vient d'un nombre relativement restreint de grands clients et de CSP, ce qui pese sur le risque de credit ; serveurs IA 16 132 M$ sur 43 842 M$ (36,8%) contre 1 882 M$ un an avant
controles.verbatim_source: To date, the majority of revenue from our AI-optimized solutions has involved purchases by a relatively small number of large customers and cloud service providers. Such purchases generally involve larger amounts of credit, and could impact our overall credit risk in trade and financing receivables. / AI-optimized servers $16,132 $1,882 ; Total net revenue 43,842

controles.affirmation: Dell anticipe que la prochaine generation de composants IA sera contrainte en approvisionnement, et souligne la non-linearite des livraisons
controles.verbatim_source: While we have seen lead times shorten, we anticipate the next generation of these components, for which demand remains high, will be subject to supply constraints. / there is inherent non-linearity in the timing of demand and subsequent shipments for our AI-optimized servers offerings, which continues to drive variability in our revenue.

controles.affirmation: Les mesures de protection commerciale (droits de douane, barrieres, politiques gouvernementales) et la volatilite geopolitique peuvent affecter les resultats sur certains marches
controles.verbatim_source: The impacts of trade protection measures, including changes in tariffs and trade barriers, changes in government policies and international trade arrangements, geopolitical volatility... may affect our results of operations in some markets.
